fusions.name: Dummy Lunge
fusions.desc: Feints, then bites for 7 damage, leaving the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds and with a 50% chance to leave it [Leaden] for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Lead Astray
fusions.desc: Silences one enemy within 7 tiles for 3 seconds and deals 8 damage, taking its next action away and knocking it back 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Decoy Trail
fusions.desc: Veils you and your allies for 6 seconds. Enemies notice you 60% later, you move 20% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Sly Opening
fusions.desc: Each time you afflict something, your next strike gains 15% critical hit chance. Once every 8 seconds.
